in_marathi.name: Menaka
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon, Mind, Intelligence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Menaka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Menaka is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manda', meaning moon. In Hindu mythology, Menaka is the name of a celestial nymph, known for her beauty and intelligence. She is also identified with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
